title: What is Slopsquatting?
summary: Thin AI-voiced explainer of slopsquatting citing a USENIX 2025 study.

assertions.quote: open-source models invent nonexistent dependencies at a 21.7% average rate, versus 5.2% for commercial ones

verdicts.note: The USENIX Security 2025 study (Spracklen et al.) measured these rates and found many hallucinated names recur, making them registrable attack targets.
